newsitem.title: POLAND: WEDEL SURGES 9.9 PCT BEFORE EARNINGS DATA.
newsitem.headline: WEDEL SURGES 9.9 PCT BEFORE EARNINGS DATA.

text.p: Polish confectioner E.Wedel Zaklady Przemyslu Cukierniczego SA (Wedel) surged 9.9 percent in active trade on Wednesday on speculation the firm would record good September earnings later this week, traders said.
"Apparently some investors think Wedel will record good results", one trader said about the firm whose stock closed at 182.5 zlotys.
Polish listed firms will release their September results by the end of the week.
